message.content:
The Northbank community garden management issues this notice regarding upcoming maintenance and schedule adjustments. The north gate will remain closed on Saturday, 18 April. Closure begins at 9 am and ends at 2 pm. Crews will repair a leaking water pipe during this window. Water access near the northern plot beds will be unavailable. Do not attempt to enter through the north gate. Barriers will block the path for safety. Use the east entrance instead. The east gate remains open throughout the day. Plan your arrival accordingly to avoid congestion at the single open entry point.

The weekly seed swap, originally scheduled for Saturday morning, moves to Sunday. The new time is 11 am. Location remains the central shed. Bring your labeled packets. Exchange surplus seeds with neighbors. This shift prevents conflict with the pipe repair work. No seeds will be distributed on Saturday.

Volunteers are needed for general cleanup after the repairs finish. Mina coordinates all volunteer efforts. Contact her directly to sign up for specific tasks. Volunteers must bring their own gardening gloves. The garden supplies shovels, rakes, and wheelbarrows. Do not bring personal tools unless requested by Mina. Safety vests are provided at the east entrance check-in table. Wear sturdy shoes. Mud may persist near the repair site. Check the bulletin board for updates if rain delays the work. We appreciate your patience during these necessary improvements. Reliable water infrastructure supports healthy plant growth throughout the season. Your cooperation ensures minimal disruption to daily gardening activities. Please share this information with fellow plot holders who may not check the online portal regularly. Direct questions to Mina via the community email list.
